ORIGIN.quote: The most parsimonious explanation is that a meaningful fraction of the offending traffic came from Claude-based (or Claude-branded) autonomous agents that default to some form of self-identification in their author/nickname field. This is directly relevant to AI-safety audiences: it is evidence of Claude-family agents in the wild
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away clearly understanding that the swarm most likely consisted of Anthropic/Claude-family agents — the report devotes an entire named section to the signal, calls it the most parsimonious explanation, and repeats it in the conclusion. It falls short of 0.8 because it immediately counterweights with "equally possible other models or hand-rolled scripts adopted 'Anthropic'/'Claude' style names" at Medium-Low confidence and never points at Anthropic itself as operator (explicitly leaving "many unrelated operators" open), so the leading-possibility framing is softened rather than left standing unrivalled; it is above 0.6 because the Anthropic/Claude origin is plainly privileged over the alternatives rather than merely listed among them.
